messages.subject: Re: optimizePenalty function Rota et al. 2016
parts:
You need certain software tools installed in addition to R in order to build the dev version of unmarked. It looks like you are on a Mac, so you need Xcode. If you haven't already installed Xcode here's a brief guide (under the Mac section): https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/articles/200486498-Package-Development-Prerequisites

If you already do have Xcode installed and you are still getting this error I'm afraid I won't be much help, as I don't have a Mac and don't have experience troubleshooting compilation issues on one. Perhaps someone else in the community has experience.
